tasks.prompt: Can you add an --older-than option to runstash prune, e.g. `runstash prune --older-than 30d`, so it only deletes runs that haven't been touched in that long? People keep losing runs they were still looking at.

Each run directory now gets a sibling `<run>.judge/` directory with the LLM-judge outputs, and those are huge. They're regenerated from the run, so we don't archive them. Make prune delete a run's judge dir along with the run, and also delete judge dirs whose run is already gone.

Integration-test runs should go to a separate bucket, `lab-run-archive-integration`, under the same prefix. Add a way to pick the bucket for push, prune and list (a --bucket flag is fine, or an INTEGRATION=1 env var), and keep the current bucket as the default.

push is slow for big sweeps because it does extra round trips to S3 for every run. Make it faster; we push hundreds of runs at the end of a sweep and the upload itself should be the only thing that takes time.

The shared GPU box ran out of disk again last night and killed three training jobs. Add a nightly cron (a crontab line in the repo plus whatever wrapper script it needs) that runs prune non-interactively, so we stop getting paged for this.
